outcome: anti-spike glycoprotein SARS-CoV-2 IgG and IgA titers in maternal blood and umbilical cord blood
cohort: 148 pregnant women who received the BNT162b2 XBB.1.5 vaccine
finding: Pregnant women who received the BNT162b2 XBB.1.5 vaccine during gestational weeks 28 to 34 had the highest titers of anti-omicron SARS-CoV-2 variant antibodies in their blood, and these antibodies were transferred to their umbilical cord blood.
